+"""Standalone copy of ``has_default_eq`` from ``_pytest.assertion.util``.
+
+This module is importable by file path without loading the ``_pytest``
+package or its runtime initialization.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+
+__all__ = ["vendored_default_equality", "vendored_default_equality_variant"]
+
+
+def isattrs(obj: Any) -> bool:
+    return getattr(obj, "__attrs_attrs__", None) is not None
+
+
+def vendored_default_equality(
+    obj: object,
+) -> bool:
+    """Check if an instance of an object contains the default eq
+
+    First, we check if the object's __eq__ attribute has __code__,
+    if so, we check the equally of the method code filename (__code__.co_filename)
+    to the default one generated by the dataclass and attr module
+    for dataclasses the default co_filename is <string>, for attrs class, the __eq__ should contain "attrs eq generated"
+    """
+    # inspired from https://github.com/willmcgugan/rich/blob/07d51ffc1aee6f16bd2e5a25b4e82850fb9ed778/rich/pretty.py#L68
+    if hasattr(obj.__eq__, "__code__") and hasattr(obj.__eq__.__code__, "co_filename"):
+        code_filename = obj.__eq__.__code__.co_filename
+
+        if isattrs(obj):
+            return "attrs generated " in code_filename
+
+        return code_filename == "<string>"  # data class
+    return True
+
+
+def vendored_default_equality_variant(
+    obj: object,
+) -> bool:
+    """Return the negation of :func:`vendored_default_equality`."""
+    return not vendored_default_equality(obj)

@@ -0,0 +1,175 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import dataclasses
+import importlib.util
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import types
+from typing import Any
+
+import pytest
+
+
+MODULE_PATH = (
+    Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+    / "src"
+    / "standalone_wave6_default_equality.py"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def mod() -> types.ModuleType:
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "standalone_wave6_default_equality_under_test", MODULE_PATH
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+    return module
+
+
+def _make_eq(filename: str) -> Any:
+    code = compile("def __eq__(self, other):\n    return True\n", filename, "exec")
+    namespace: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    exec(code, namespace)
+    return namespace["__eq__"]
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class _DataclassDefault:
+    x: int = 0
+
+
+@dataclasses.dataclass
+class _DataclassCustom:
+    x: int = 0
+
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    __hash__ = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
+
+
+class _Empty:
+    pass
+
+
+class _FakeAttrs:
+    __attrs_attrs__ = ()
+    __eq__ = _make_eq("<attrs generated eq tests.Foo>")
+
+
+class _FakeAttrsCustom:
+    __attrs_attrs__ = ()
+
+    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    __hash__ = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
+
+
+class _AttrsNoneMarker:
+    __attrs_attrs__ = None
+    __eq__ = _make_eq("<attrs generated eq tests.Foo>")
+
+
+class _CodeWithoutFilename:
+    __eq__ = types.SimpleNamespace(__code__=object())  # type: ignore[assignment]
+
+
+class _RaisingDescriptor:
+    def __get__(self, obj: object, objtype: type | None = None) -> Any:
+        raise RuntimeError("boom")
+
+
+class _RaisingEq:
+    __eq__ = _RaisingDescriptor()
+
+
+def test_import_does_not_load_pytest_assertion_util(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    tree = ast.parse(MODULE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imported: set[str] = set()
+    for node in ast.walk(tree):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+            imported.update(alias.name.split(".")[0] for alias in node.names)
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+            imported.add((node.module or "").split(".")[0])
+    assert imported <= {"__future__", "typing"}
+    assert mod.__all__ == [
+        "vendored_default_equality",
+        "vendored_default_equality_variant",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_isattrs(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    assert mod.isattrs(_FakeAttrs())
+    assert not mod.isattrs(_Empty())
+    assert not mod.isattrs(_AttrsNoneMarker())
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("obj", "expected"),
+    [
+        (_DataclassDefault(), True),
+        (_DataclassCustom(), False),
+        (_FakeAttrs(), True),
+        (_FakeAttrsCustom(), False),
+        # Builtins and plain classes have no Python-level __eq__ code object.
+        (_Empty(), True),
+        (1, True),
+        ("", True),
+        ([], True),
+        ({}, True),
+        (None, True),
+        (_CodeWithoutFilename(), True),
+    ],
+)
+def test_vendored_default_equality(
+    mod: types.ModuleType, obj: object, expected: bool
+) -> None:
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality(obj) is expected
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality_variant(obj) is (not expected)
+
+
+def test_non_attrs_object_with_attrs_like_filename(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    class NotAttrs:
+        __eq__ = _make_eq("<attrs generated eq tests.Foo>")
+
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality(NotAttrs()) is False
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality_variant(NotAttrs()) is True
+
+
+def test_attrs_none_marker_uses_dataclass_rule(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality(_AttrsNoneMarker()) is False
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality_variant(_AttrsNoneMarker()) is True
+
+
+def test_string_filename_is_default(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    class Generated:
+        __eq__ = _make_eq("<string>")
+
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality(Generated()) is True
+    assert mod.vendored_default_equality_variant(Generated()) is False
+
+
+def test_errors_propagate(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
+        mod.vendored_default_equality(_RaisingEq())
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="boom"):
+        mod.vendored_default_equality_variant(_RaisingEq())
+
+
+def test_missing_argument_raises(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        mod.vendored_default_equality()
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
+        mod.vendored_default_equality_variant()
+
+
+def test_matches_reference_when_available(mod: types.ModuleType) -> None:
+    util = sys.modules.get("_pytest.assertion.util")
+    if util is None:
+        pytest.skip("reference module not loaded")
+    for obj in (_DataclassDefault(), _DataclassCustom(), _FakeAttrs(), _Empty(), 1):
+        assert mod.vendored_default_equality(obj) == util.has_default_eq(obj)
notes:
Copied has_default_eq verbatim (signature, docstring, body) as vendored_default_equality plus a local isattrs helper, with only __future__/typing imports, and added a wrapper returning its negation. Tests load the module via importlib spec_from_file_location and cover dataclass/attrs-like/custom/builtin/empty objects, missing args and propagated errors.
